implementation.shared_state: Existing page-owned OverviewState and existing event handlers; no filter-state copy
implementation.desktop: Two rows: ending input + button, region, kind, mode, additional-filter popover; suggestions + dataset + card count + reset + share
implementation.mobile: Same model in Nuxt UI modal; hidden desktop fields are display:none; three featured suggestions and More
implementation.icons: Ten local SVG icons through Nuxt UI / Nuxt Icon, explicitly bundled; 2.05 KB uncompressed. Select chevrons use the same local SVG asset.
implementation.reset: Visible label Zurücksetzen as in the reference; accessible name, description and tooltip explicitly state that only standard endings are restored.
implementation.data_path: No changes to API, loader, cache, normalization or URL schema. SVG geometry, circle coordinates/radii, counts and numeric scales are unchanged.
implementation.sharing: Existing URL synchronization; clipboard failures are now explicit errors; URL-length checks retained, permanent technical hint removed

mockup_refinement.layout: Centered header navigation, 72px header, approximately 47px main insets at reference width; 5-column map grid with 12px gaps.
mockup_refinement.toolbar: Column proportions follow the reference; 44px primary controls; four suggestion pills, a discreet More menu, metadata from dataset label/year, short Reset and Share actions.
mockup_refinement.legend: Short Methodik label and decorative existing color ramp. The exact numeric ranges remain under each card; zero and no-data states remain distinct.
mockup_refinement.cards: Removed empty variant rows; reorder controls remain available inside the editor; local pencil/close/info/share SVG icons.

production_ssr.execution: Production Nuxt SSR through localFetch with the listener replaced by a no-op, no network or browser
